title: OF GOD THE HOLY GHOST. XX. LORD'S DAY.

segments.text: Queſt. 53d. What doſt thou believe concerning the Holy Ghoſt?

Anſ. Firſt, That He is true and co-eternal God with the Father and the Son: Secondly, that He is alſo given me, to make me by a true Faith, Partaker of Chriſt and all his Benefits, that He may comfort me, and abide with me forever.
